record.name: Jira
record.one_liner: Jira Cloud platform REST API for interacting with Jira programmatically, building apps, or automating workflows.

auth.notes: Supports basic authentication using an Atlassian account email address and API token, as well as OAuth 2.0 (3LO) and JWT-based authentication for Connect apps.

access.notes: Developers can generate API tokens for their Atlassian account and create OAuth 2.0 or Forge apps via the developer console.

api_surface.notes: Exposes a comprehensive REST API and webhooks for integrations.
